analystPolicies.futureAwardPolicy: Repeat FY2025 gross new option+RSU count as a constant share-pool percentage each December, beginning December 2026; assume full vesting, one share for every option and no exercise proceeds. This is an analyst upper-claim cost, not an issuer commitment or expected accounting SBC.
analystPolicies.currentClaimsPolicy: June maximum shares, reduced only by verified August withheld shares. All remaining awards vest and all options become a full share with zero exercise proceeds: a conservative claim upper bound, NOT exact option fair value or current issued shares.
analystPolicies.operatingPolicy: Cash profit before operating-WC movement and capex, after cash tax, all lease principal/interest and other interest. Hold scenario's observed margin constant: no assumed efficiency uplift beyond the selected historical observation.
analystPolicies.workingCapitalPolicy: Use observed operating-WC cash benefit per incremental annual revenue, not a perpetual CFO/revenue margin. Base uses latest complete TTM, downside FY2025. No repeated supplier-finance repayment deduction or cash borrowing credit.
analystPolicies.investmentPolicy: FY2026 uses disclosed 5,250m mixed cash/noncash budget. All 1,205m unallocated balance becomes a recurring revenue-scaled capital allowance (NOT reported maintenance); 4,045m expansion allocation scales with incremental revenue. Forecast investment includes software/intangibles, so no second future intangible-capex charge. The Q1 cash/deployment fraction is normalized by adding separately reported cash intangibles to both numerator and denominator; FY2025 uses the equivalent inclusive fraction for downside. This analyst all-capital normalization does not relabel the issuer's Q1 budget deployment. Building leases and financed-equipment servicing remain inside operating cash profit; other principal uses actual TTM/revenue. This is a ratio-based refinancing forecast, not a verified debt amortization schedule.
analystPolicies.cashPolicy: Reserve June cash/revenue for operations and deduct future reserve increases. Carry the reported rounded USD bank deposits in USD; no interest or option-cash credit. H2 annual-minus-H1 forecast is spread uniformly over H2 for the as-of nowcast. Attribute remaining bank deposits and H2 net cash economically at December 2026 after that year's award batch; subsequent FCFE is available at each year end. These are valuation distributions, not a dividend forecast; covenants can restrict actual payouts.
analystPolicies.discountPolicy: USD Ke = default-adjusted 10Y Treasury + beta*mature ERP + Mexico CRP + explicit execution premium. Convert nominal USD Ke to nominal MXN with (1+KeUSD)*(1+MXN inflation)/(1+USD inflation)-1. Inflation targets are analyst long-run currency assumptions, not observable FX forward prices. Terminal company revenue grows at MXN 3%; terminal per-current-claim growth also subtracts continued new-award dilution.

base.label: Analyst conservative baseline
base.rationale: Latest full-year cash profitability and WC terms; no additional operating leverage; latest disclosed equipment-financing mix; 100bp discretionary expansion/execution hurdle.

downside.label: Funding and cash-conversion stress
downside.rationale: Cash profit and WC return to FY2025, and more investment is cash-funded as in FY2025; 200bp execution hurdle. A funding deficit invalidates a standalone financed-path claim and is reported explicitly.

upside.label: Historical-margin recovery
upside.rationale: Cash profit recovers only to the observed FY2024 margin while TTM WC terms and Q1 financing continue; no discretionary extra execution premium. Not a probability-weighted price target.

limits: Exact June option tranche rollforward is not established; full-share upper claims deliberately avoid requiring an invented tranche allocation or time-value reserve.
Known August exercises do not establish a new complete company-wide current issued-share count; the maximum-claim rollforward is used, not a claimed September basic-share fact.
FY2026 full-year cash/noncash budget split remains unknown as a reported fact; forecasts use explicit observed-ratio estimates and a stressed alternative.

No mature/new-store cohort cash-profit or maintenance schedule was established. The selected actual aggregate margin and conservative recurring capital allowance are analyst estimates, not audited forecasts.
Future award count, financing renewals, inflation parity, cash availability and growth taper are forecasts. No market quote or target calibration is used.
The TTM cash bridge has a documented 0.363m PPE-disposal comparator inconsistency. Current input uses the audited local-PIT reconciliation unchanged.
These scenarios have analytical anchors but are not statistical confidence bounds. The baseline is deliberately conservative in equity-claim treatment, not a guaranteed floor on realizable value.
